import numpy as np

X = np.array([[0, 0], [0, 1], [1, 0], [1, 1]])
y = np.array([[0], [1], [1], [0]])

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
W1 = rng.normal(size=(2, 4))
b1 = np.zeros((1, 4))
W2 = rng.normal(size=(4, 1))
b2 = np.zeros((1, 1))

lr = 0.5
for epoch in range(10000):
    out = forward(X)
    loss = mse(out, y)
    g = backward(X, y, out)
    W1 -= lr * g['W1']; b1 -= lr * g['b1']
    W2 -= lr * g['W2']; b2 -= lr * g['b2']
    if epoch % 1000 == 0:
        print(f'epoch {epoch} loss {loss:.4f}')

print(forward(X).round())
